sources.method: Entry-level search locator used for orientation only; specific statements are checked against the higher-tier reference and official records where available.

statement.zh: **攻击**：肩窥（Shoulder Surfing）。肩窥是观察攻击：攻击者在你输入 PIN、密码、图案或验证码时直接看、拍或录。它不破解密码算法，而是降低“秘密”的有效熵。设字符集大小 C、长度 L，原始熵 H0=L log2 C。若攻击者看到 k 个位置的准确字符，剩余熵 H_eff=(L-k)log2 C；若只看到这 k 个字符的集合但不知道位置，剩余组合数为 C^(L-k)·P(L,k)，熵为 (L-k)log2 C+log2 P(L,k)。多次观察的经验成功率不是简单独立叠加；若单次成功概率为 p，n 次独立观察可近似 P_n=1-(1-p)^n，但真实攻击有学习效应和角度差异，应用实验基线校准。
statement.en: **Attack**: Shoulder Surfing (肩窥).Shoulder surfing is an observation attack: an attacker directly watches, photographs or records a PIN, password, pattern or one-time code as it is entered.

statement.zh: 移动设备在公共交通、会议室、咖啡厅被肩窥的风险高；6 位 PIN 单次观察 10.8%，多次 26.5%；6 点图案单次 64.2%，多次 79.9%；去掉反馈线降到 35.3%/52.1%。这说明“图案比 PIN 更直观”不等于更安全。肩窥还会泄露验证码、支付密码、聊天内容；对高价值账户，观察一次就足以降低后续暴力或猜测成本。
statement.en: Mobile devices are exposed on transit, in meeting rooms and in cafés.A 6-digit PIN is attacked 10.8% of the time from one observation and 26.5% from multiple observations; a 6-dot pattern is 64.2% and 79.9%; removing feedback lines lowers it to 35.3%/52.1%.

statement.zh: 防护：隐私屏或防窥膜、身体遮挡、在可信环境输入、使用生物识别或硬件密钥、限制屏幕可视角度、随机化键盘、隐藏反馈线、短时验证码。攻击侧：直接观察、手机录像、远摄镜头、屏幕反射、AI 视频分析。防御评估应测不同角度、距离、手机尺寸和手部遮挡，而不是只看单张截图。
statement.en: Defense: privacy screens or films, body shielding, entry in trusted settings, biometrics or hardware keys, limited viewing angles, randomized keyboards, hidden feedback lines and short-lived codes.Attack: direct observation, phone video, telephoto lenses, screen reflections and AI video analysis.

statement.zh: 失效：实验室视频与实际场景差异；角度、光线和遮挡；用户快速输入；观察者记忆有限；多因素认证使单次密码泄露不足；但摄像头和慢动作会放大。
statement.en:
Failure: laboratory videos differ from real scenes; angle, light and occlusion; fast user entry; limited observer memory; multi-factor authentication makes a single password leak insufficient; but cameras and slow motion amplify it.### Formal model

Adv_A = Pr[Succ_A] − Pr[Succ_ideal]；Cost = D × T × M；Success = 1[advantage > threshold].

statement.zh:
肩窥随 ATM、电话亭和移动设备普及而受关注；2017 年大规模在线实验（n=1173）建立移动解锁基线；2019 年研究把不同认证方法的观察难度放在同一实验框架；ACM 2017 论文提供了同行评议记录。后续研究继续比较 PIN、图案、文本密码和图形密码的可观察性。**技术参数与复算边界**

本条的形式模型是 \(\mathrm{Adv}^{\mathrm{attack}}_A(\lambda)=\Pr[\mathrm{Game}_A(\lambda)=1]-\frac12\)。输入：输入：肩窥的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：λ 安全参数；Game 把攻击目标写成挑战-响应游戏。
statement.en: Shoulder surfing gained attention with ATMs, phone booths and mobile devices.A 2017 large online experiment (n=1173) established mobile-unlock baselines; a 2019 study put different authentication methods into one experimental framework; the ACM 2017 paper provides a peer-reviewed record.
